topic: AC1018 unreferenced empty-name STYLE selected DXF output

local_libdxfrw.read: The local adapter imports all six STYLE records; the typed model retains the empty row without changing caller data.

source_json.reference_scan: A recursive scan of the independently decoded JSON found no handle reference to 0xDF outside the STYLE_CONTROL membership and the STYLE record's own identity.

independent_consumer.claim_limit: Independent open-source consumer evidence for this source only; not native AutoCAD or platform qualification.

unresolved_field_difference: For handle 0xDF, LibreDWG's trace reports group-70 flag 65 (shape bit set, xref-dependent bit set); the local typed model reports flags=68 (vertical bit set, xref-dependent bit set). The selected-output omission does not depend on this flag. ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.56 lists Vertical then shape-file fields for AC1018, while LibreDWG's trace associates the source bits in the opposite order. Resolve this spec/peer/native discrepancy before claiming parser-level shape-font parity.

implementation.behavior: For a sourceFormat-Unknown selected output projection only, omit an empty-name STYLE when its modeled entity, shape-linetype, dimension, MLeader, table, and retained raw-resource dependencies are absent. Keep the omission fail-closed when opaque reference-bearing families are present. Any referenced or otherwise unproven empty-name row is explicitly refused, including a shape-style row whose flags would otherwise pass the generic STYLE payload validator.
implementation.diagnostic: Successful omission writes a stderr diagnostic with the omitted source handle; suppression is not silent.
implementation.caller_state: The source STYLE remains empty-named and unchanged. The selected projection omits only that row; the five named source rows remain.
